##### June 18, 2026


The A10 AI Firewall secured Interop’s Best of Show Runner’s Up at the 2026 event. The A10 AI Firewall is a guardrail solution to protect LLMs and AI applications from AI‑native threats, with custom policy enforcement, built‑in governance, and in‑depth visibility.
